SELECT [tblMold].[MoldNo], [tblMold].MaKhuonKetHop, [tblMold].IDTenKH
FROM tblMold
WHERE ((([tblMold].IDTenKH)=[txtIDTenKH]))
ORDER BY [tblMold].MaKhuonKetHop DESC;

SELECT [tblMold].MaKhuonKetHop, [tblMold].IDTenKH, [tblMold].[MoldNo]
FROM tblMold
WHERE ((([tblMold].IDTenKH)=[txtIDTenKH]))
ORDER BY [tblMold].MaKhuonKetHop DESC;

SELECT [KhuonDinhHinhTblOld].MaKhuonKetHop, [KhuonDinhHinhTblOld].IDTenKH, [KhuonDinhHinhTblOld].MaSoKhuon
FROM KhuonDinhHinhTblOld
WHERE ((([KhuonDinhHinhTblOld].IDTenKH)=[txtIDTenKH]))
ORDER BY [KhuonDinhHinhTblOld].MaKhuonKetHop DESC;

SELECT tblProcessingDeadline.ProcessingDeadlineID, tblProcessingDeadline.ProcessingDeadline
FROM tblProcessingDeadline
WHERE (((tblProcessingDeadline.JobID)=[Forms]![frmDailyWorkLog]![frmDailyWorkLogSubList]![cboJobCodeAuto]))
ORDER BY tblProcessingDeadline.ProcessingDeadline;

SELECT T4_JOB.IDjobno, T2_Nhom.TenNhom, T3_Khuon.KichThuocKhuon, T4_JOB.HanGiaoHang, T4_JOB.hanhoanthanh
FROM (T2_Nhom INNER JOIN T3_Khuon ON T2_Nhom.IDNhom = T3_Khuon.IDNhom) INNER JOIN T4_JOB ON T3_Khuon.IDKhuon = T4_JOB.IDKhuon;

SELECT T4_JOB.*, [T3_KetCauNhomGC].[TenKetCauNhomGC], T2_May.IDMay, T1_KhachHang.IDkhachhang, T2_May.[TenMay], T1_KhachHang.tenkhachhang
FROM (T1_KhachHang INNER JOIN T2_May ON T1_KhachHang.IDkhachhang = T2_May.IDkhachhang) INNER JOIN (T3_KetCauNhomGC INNER JOIN T4_JOB ON [T3_KetCauNhomGC].[IDKetCauNhomGC]=T4_JOB.[IDKetCauNhomGC]) ON T2_May.IDMay=[T3_KetCauNhomGC].IDMay;

SELECT tblMold.MoldID, tblMold.MoldName, tblMold.MoldCodeAuto, tblMold.MoldCode, tblMold.DefaultPlasticType, tblMold.TrayID, tblMold.MoldDesignID, tblMold.CustomerID, tblMold.[MoldNumber], tblMold.RackLayerID, tblMold.ItemTypeID, tblRackLayer.RackCompanyNote, tblRackLayer.RackLayerNotes, tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignName, tblMold.MoldEntry, tblMold.LastShipmentDate, tblMold.MoldCodeCheck, tblMold.MoldLength, tblMold.MoldWidth, tblMold.MoldHeight, tblMold.MoldWeight, tblMold.MoldCategory, tblMold.MoldUsageStatus, tblMold.MoldProcessStatus
FROM tblRackLayer INNER JOIN (tblMoldDesign RIGHT JOIN tblMold ON tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignID = tblMold.MoldDesignID) ON tblRackLayer.RackLayerID = tblMold.RackLayerID;

SELECT tblMold.*, tblMoldDesign.*, tblRack.RackLocation, tblRackLayer.RackLayerNotes, tblRackLayer.RackLayerNumber
FROM tblRack INNER JOIN ((tblMoldDesign INNER JOIN tblMold ON tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignID = tblMold.MoldDesignID) INNER JOIN tblRackLayer ON tblMold.RackLayerID = tblRackLayer.RackLayerID) ON tblRack.RackID = tblRackLayer.RackID;

SELECT tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignName, tblJOB.JobName, tblJOB.JobCode, tblJOB.JobID, tblJOB.MoldDesignID, tblJOB.MoldID, tblJOB.DeliveryDeadline, tblProcessingDeadline.JobID AS PDJobID, tblProcessingDeadline.ProcessingDeadline, tblProcessingDeadline.ItemTypeID, tblProcessingDeadline.ProcessingNotes, tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignCode, tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignLength, tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignWidth, tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignHeight, tblMoldDesign.CutlineX, tblMoldDesign.CutlineY, tblMoldDesign.CornerR, tblMoldDesign.ChamferC, [CutlineX] & "x" & [CutlineY] AS Cutline
FROM (tblMoldDesign INNER JOIN tblJOB ON tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignID = tblJOB.MoldDesignID) INNER JOIN tblProcessingDeadline ON tblJOB.JobID = tblProcessingDeadline.JobID
WHERE tblProcessingDeadline.ItemTypeID = 7
ORDER BY tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignName, tblJOB.JobID;

SELECT [KhuonDinhHinhTblOld].MaKhuonKetHop, [KhuonDinhHinhTblOld].IDTenKH, [KhuonDinhHinhTblOld].MaSoKhuon
FROM KhuonDinhHinhTblOld
WHERE ((([KhuonDinhHinhTblOld].IDTenKH)=[txtIDTenKH]))
ORDER BY [KhuonDinhHinhTblOld].MaKhuonKetHop DESC;

SELECT tblProcessingDeadline.*, tblJOB.JobName
FROM tblJOB INNER JOIN tblProcessingDeadline ON tblJOB.JobID=[tblProcessingDeadline].JobID;

SELECT [tblMoldCutter].[MoldCutterID], [tblMoldCutter].IDnukigata, [tblMoldCutter].IDSttKhuonDinhHinh, [KhuonDinhHinhTblOld].IDTenKH, [KhuonDinhHinhTblOld].MaSoKhuon, [KhuonDinhHinhTblOld].MaKhuonKetHop, [tblMoldCutter].[DateEntry], [tblMoldCutter].[MoldCutterNotes]
FROM tblCutter INNER JOIN (KhuonDinhHinhTblOld INNER JOIN tblMoldCutter ON [KhuonDinhHinhTblOld].IDsttKhuonDinhHinh=[tblMoldCutter].IDSttKhuonDinhHinh) ON [tblCutter].[CutterNo]=[tblMoldCutter].IDnukigata;

SELECT tblMold.MoldID, tblMold.CustomerID, tblMold.[MoldNumber], tblMold.RackLayerID, tblMold.MoldNotes, tblMold.LastOrderDate, tblMold.MoldDescription
FROM tblRackLayer INNER JOIN (tblCustomer INNER JOIN tblMold ON tblCustomer.CustomerID = tblMold.CustomerID) ON tblRackLayer.RackLayerID = tblMold.RackLayerID;

SELECT tblMold.*, tblRack.*, tblCustomer.CustomerShortName, tblRackLayer.RackLayerNumber, tblRackLayer.RackLayerNotes, tblRackLayer.RackCompanyNote
FROM (tblRack INNER JOIN tblRackLayer ON tblRack.RackID = tblRackLayer.RackID) INNER JOIN (tblCustomer INNER JOIN tblMold ON tblCustomer.CustomerID = tblMold.CustomerID) ON tblRackLayer.RackLayerID = tblMold.RackLayerID;

SELECT tblMold.MoldID, tblMold.[MoldNumber], tblMold.RackLayerID, tblMold.MoldNotes, tblMold.LastOrderDate, tblMold.MoldDescription, tblCustomer.*
FROM tblCustomer INNER JOIN tblMold ON tblCustomer.CustomerID = tblMold.CustomerID;

SELECT tblMold.RackLayerID, tblMold.MoldID, tblMold.MoldNotes, tblMold.LastOrderDate, tblMold.MoldDescription, tblCustomer.*
FROM tblCustomer INNER JOIN tblMold ON tblCustomer.CustomerID = tblMold.CustomerID;

SELECT tblMoldCutter.*, tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignName, tblCutter.CutterNo
FROM (tblMoldDesign INNER JOIN tblCutter ON tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignID = tblCutter.MoldDesignID) INNER JOIN tblMoldCutter ON (tblCutter.CutterID = tblMoldCutter.CutterID) AND (tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignID = tblMoldCutter.MoldDesignID);

SELECT tblProcessingDeadline.*, [tblItemType].IDDC, [tblItemType].[ItemTypeName]
FROM tblItemType INNER JOIN tblProcessingDeadline ON [tblItemType].IDCapDC=[tblProcessingDeadline].IDCapDC;

SELECT tblProcessingDeadline.*, [tblItemType].IDDC, [tblItemType].[ItemTypeName]
FROM tblItemType INNER JOIN tblProcessingDeadline ON [tblItemType].IDCapDC=[tblProcessingDeadline].IDCapDC;

SELECT tblProcessingDeadline.*, [tblItemType].IDDC, [tblItemType].[ItemTypeName]
FROM tblItemType INNER JOIN tblProcessingDeadline ON [tblItemType].IDCapDC=[tblProcessingDeadline].IDCapDC;

SELECT tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignName, tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignLength, tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignWidth, tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignHeight, tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignWeight, tblMoldBorrow.MoldDesignID, tblMoldBorrow.MoldPicture, tblMoldBorrow.MoldPictureLink, tblMoldBorrow.MoldSheetTitle, tblMoldBorrow.EquipmentNo
FROM tblMoldDesign INNER JOIN tblMoldBorrow ON tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignID = tblMoldBorrow.MoldDesignID;

SELECT tblMoldBorrow.*, tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignLength, tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignWidth, tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignHeight, tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignWeight, [copytblAssetInfo].JAEname, tblMoldDesign.PieceCount, tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignName
FROM (tblMoldDesign INNER JOIN copytblAssetInfo ON tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignID=[copytblAssetInfo].MoldDesignID) INNER JOIN tblMoldBorrow ON tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignID = tblMoldBorrow.MoldDesignID;

SELECT tblWorkLog.WorkLogID, tblJOB.JobName, tblWorkLog.ProcessingTime, tblWorkLog.ProcessingDate
FROM tblMold INNER JOIN (tblJOB INNER JOIN (tblProcessingDeadline INNER JOIN tblWorkLog ON tblProcessingDeadline.ProcessingDeadlineID = tblWorkLog.ProcessingDeadlineID) ON tblJOB.JobID = tblProcessingDeadline.JobID) ON tblMold.MoldID = tblJOB.MoldID;

SELECT T5_DrawingVer.IDDrawingVer, [T_VatLieuNhua].IDVatLieu, [T_VatLieuNhua].MoTaChiTiet, [T_VatLieuNhua].[TypeVL], [T_VatLieuNhua].VL, [T_VatLieuNhua].KichThuocPhoi, [T_VatLieuNhua].[GroupVL], [T_VatLieuNhua].[ghichuVl], [T_VatLieuNhua].UuTienGC, T_HinhDangVL.HinhDang, [T_ChonBvGiaCong].IDJobNo
FROM (T5_DrawingVer INNER JOIN T_ChonBvGiaCong ON T5_DrawingVer.IDDrawingVer=[T_ChonBvGiaCong].[IDBanVe]) INNER JOIN (T_HinhDangVL INNER JOIN T_VatLieuNhua ON T_HinhDangVL.IDHinhDangVL=[T_VatLieuNhua].IDHinhDangVL) ON T5_DrawingVer.IDDrawingVer=[T_VatLieuNhua].IDDrawingVer;

INSERT INTO tblOrderHead ( OrderNo, CustomerID, OrderDate, RequestedDeliveryDate, OrderStatus, CustomerPO, ContactPerson, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt, Notes )
SELECT 'SO-SAMPLE-20260310-01', CustomerID, Date(), DateAdd('d', 7, Date()), 'NEW', 'PO-SAMPLE-20260310-01', 'seed-min', Now(), Now(), 'seed-min-20260310-01'
FROM qrySeedSource_MinProd
WHERE NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT *
        FROM tblOrderHead
        WHERE OrderNo = 'SO-SAMPLE-20260310-01'
    );

CREATE TABLE tblDesignCutters (
    DesignID INT,                      
    CutterID INT,                      
    PRIMARY KEY (DesignID, CutterID),
    FOREIGN KEY (DesignID) REFERENCES tblDesigns(DesignID), 
    FOREIGN KEY (CutterID) REFERENCES tblCutters(CutterID)
);

SELECT [tblJOB].IDjobno, [tblJOB].[DeliveryDeadline], [KhuonThietKeTbl].IDMaKhuonThietKe, [KhuonThietKeTbl].IDMaKhuonDH, [tblJOB].IDJobno & " " & [ProcessingNotes] & " " & [JobNote] AS GhiChuTH, [tblJOB].[JobNote], [tblJOB].[FormingLocation], [tblJOB].[SeparateCutter], [tblJOB].[TeflonShippingDate], [tblJOB].[TeflonRecept], [tblJOB].[PostProductionFeedback], [tblJOB].[JobQuantity], [tblJOB].[ReleasePeriod], [KhuonThietKeTbl].LoaiNhua, [KhuonThietKeTbl].KieuLapKhuon, [KhuonThietKeTbl].IDCAV, [tblProcessingItem].[ProcessingItemName], [tblMachiningCustomer].[MachiningCustomer], [tblProcessingDeadline].[ProcessingDeadline], [tblProcessingDeadline].IDTinhTrangGC, [tblProcessingStatus].TinhTrangGiaCong, [tblJOB].[MonthPeriod], [tblJOB].[MoldShippingDate], [tblJOB].[Approved], IIf(Weekday([DeliveryDeadline])=1,"土",(IIf(Weekday([DeliveryDeadline])=2,"月",(IIf(Weekday([DeliveryDeadline])=3,"火",(IIf(Weekday([DeliveryDeadline])=4,"水",(IIf(Weekday([DeliveryDeadline])=5,"木",(IIf(Weekday([DeliveryDeadline])=6,"金","日"))))))))))) AS HanGHWeekDay, IIf(Weekday([ProcessingDeadline])=7,"土",(IIf(Weekday([ProcessingDeadline])=2,"月",(IIf(Weekday([ProcessingDeadline])=3,"火",(IIf(Weekday([ProcessingDeadline])=4,"水",(IIf(Weekday([ProcessingDeadline])=5,"木",(IIf(Weekday([ProcessingDeadline])=6,"金","日"))))))))))) AS HanGCWeekDay
FROM (tblProcessingItem INNER JOIN (KhuonThietKeTbl INNER JOIN tblJOB ON KhuonThietKeTbl.IDMaKhuonThietKe=[tblJOB].IDMaKhuonThietKe) ON [tblProcessingItem].[ProcessingItemID]=[tblJOB].[ProcessingItemID]) INNER JOIN (tblProcessingStatus INNER JOIN (tblMachiningCustomer INNER JOIN tblProcessingDeadline ON [tblMachiningCustomer].[MachiningCustomerID]=[tblProcessingDeadline].[MachiningCustomerID]) ON [tblProcessingStatus].IDTinhTrangGC=[tblProcessingDeadline].IDTinhTrangGC) ON [tblJOB].IDjobno=[tblProcessingDeadline].IDJobNo
GROUP BY [tblJOB].IDjobno, [tblJOB].[DeliveryDeadline], [KhuonThietKeTbl].IDMaKhuonThietKe, [KhuonThietKeTbl].IDMaKhuonDH, [tblJOB].IDJobno & " " & [ProcessingNotes] & " " & [JobNote], [tblJOB].[JobNote], [tblJOB].[FormingLocation], [tblJOB].[SeparateCutter], [tblJOB].[TeflonShippingDate], [tblJOB].[TeflonRecept], [tblJOB].[PostProductionFeedback], [tblJOB].[JobQuantity], [tblJOB].[ReleasePeriod], [KhuonThietKeTbl].LoaiNhua, [KhuonThietKeTbl].KieuLapKhuon, [KhuonThietKeTbl].IDCAV, [tblProcessingItem].[ProcessingItemName], [tblMachiningCustomer].[MachiningCustomer], [tblProcessingDeadline].[ProcessingDeadline], [tblProcessingDeadline].IDTinhTrangGC, [tblProcessingStatus].TinhTrangGiaCong, [tblJOB].[MonthPeriod], [tblJOB].[MoldShippingDate], [tblJOB].[Approved]
ORDER BY [tblJOB].IDjobno;

SELECT T_JOB.IDjobno, T_JOB.HanGiaoHang, T_ThietKe.IDThietKe, T_ThietKe.IDMaKhuon, [T_Job].[IDJobno] & " " & [KyHanGCMemo] & " " & [GhiChuJob] AS GhiChuTH, T_JOB.GhiChuJob, T_JOB.NoiDinhHinh, T_JOB.DaoCatRieng, T_JOB.NgayChiDinhTeflon, T_JOB.NgayXacNhanTeflon, T_JOB.PhanHoiSauSX, T_JOB.SoLuongGC, T_JOB.KyPhatHanh, T_ThietKe.LoaiNhua, T_ThietKe.KieuLapKhuon, T_ThietKe.IDCAV, T_NhomGC.TenNhomGC, T_KhachHangGC.KhachHangGC, T_KyHanGC.HanGC, T_KyHanGC.IDTinhTrangGC, T_TinhTrangGC.TinhTrangGiaCong, T_JOB.KyThang, T_JOB.NgayGuiKhuon, T_JOB.DaDuyet
FROM (T_NhomGC INNER JOIN (T_ThietKe INNER JOIN T_JOB ON T_ThietKe.[IDThietKe] = T_JOB.[IDThietKe]) ON T_NhomGC.IDNhomGC = T_JOB.IDNhomGC) INNER JOIN (T_TinhTrangGC INNER JOIN (T_KhachHangGC INNER JOIN T_KyHanGC ON T_KhachHangGC.[IDKhachHangGC] = T_KyHanGC.IDKHGiaCong) ON T_TinhTrangGC.IDTinhTrangGC = T_KyHanGC.IDTinhTrangGC) ON T_JOB.IDjobno = T_KyHanGC.IDJobNo
GROUP BY T_JOB.IDjobno, T_JOB.HanGiaoHang, T_ThietKe.IDThietKe, T_ThietKe.IDMaKhuon, [T_Job].[IDJobno] & " " & [KyHanGCMemo] & " " & [GhiChuJob], T_JOB.GhiChuJob, T_JOB.NoiDinhHinh, T_JOB.DaoCatRieng, T_JOB.NgayChiDinhTeflon, T_JOB.NgayXacNhanTeflon, T_JOB.PhanHoiSauSX, T_JOB.SoLuongGC, T_JOB.KyPhatHanh, T_ThietKe.LoaiNhua, T_ThietKe.KieuLapKhuon, T_ThietKe.IDCAV, T_NhomGC.TenNhomGC, T_KhachHangGC.KhachHangGC, T_KyHanGC.HanGC, T_KyHanGC.IDTinhTrangGC, T_TinhTrangGC.TinhTrangGiaCong, T_JOB.KyThang, T_JOB.NgayGuiKhuon, T_JOB.DaDuyet, T_ThietKe.LoaiNhua
ORDER BY T_JOB.IDjobno;

SELECT T_JOB.IDjobno, T_JOB.HanGiaoHang, T_ThietKe.IDThietKe, T_ThietKe.IDMaKhuon, [T_Job].[IDJobno] & " " & [KyHanGCMemo] & " " & [GhiChuJob] AS GhiChuTH, T_JOB.GhiChuJob, T_JOB.NoiDinhHinh, T_JOB.DaoCatRieng, T_JOB.NgayChiDinhTeflon, T_JOB.NgayXacNhanTeflon, T_JOB.PhanHoiSauSX, T_JOB.SoLuongGC, T_JOB.KyPhatHanh, T_ThietKe.LoaiNhua, T_ThietKe.KieuLapKhuon, T_ThietKe.IDCAV, T_NhomGC.TenNhomGC, T_KhachHangGC.KhachHangGC
FROM (T_NhomGC INNER JOIN (T_ThietKe INNER JOIN T_JOB ON T_ThietKe.[IDThietKe] = T_JOB.[IDThietKe]) ON T_NhomGC.IDNhomGC = T_JOB.IDNhomGC) INNER JOIN (T_KhachHangGC INNER JOIN T_KyHanGC ON T_KhachHangGC.[IDKhachHangGC] = T_KyHanGC.IDKHGiaCong) ON T_JOB.IDjobno = T_KyHanGC.IDJobNo
GROUP BY T_JOB.IDjobno, T_JOB.HanGiaoHang, T_ThietKe.IDThietKe, T_ThietKe.IDMaKhuon, [T_Job].[IDJobno] & " " & [KyHanGCMemo] & " " & [GhiChuJob], T_JOB.GhiChuJob, T_JOB.NoiDinhHinh, T_JOB.DaoCatRieng, T_JOB.NgayChiDinhTeflon, T_JOB.NgayXacNhanTeflon, T_JOB.PhanHoiSauSX, T_JOB.SoLuongGC, T_JOB.KyPhatHanh, T_ThietKe.LoaiNhua, T_ThietKe.KieuLapKhuon, T_ThietKe.IDCAV, T_NhomGC.TenNhomGC, T_KhachHangGC.KhachHangGC, T_ThietKe.LoaiNhua
ORDER BY T_JOB.IDjobno;

SELECT T_ThietKe.IDMaKhuon, T_JOB.HanGiaoHang, T_NhomGC.TenNhomGC, T_JOB.IDjobno, T_ThoiLuongGC.NgayGC
FROM ((T_NhomGC INNER JOIN (T_Khuon INNER JOIN (T_ThietKe INNER JOIN T_JOB ON T_ThietKe.[IDThietKe] = T_JOB.[IDThietKe]) ON T_Khuon.IDMaKhuon = T_ThietKe.IDMaKhuon) ON T_NhomGC.IDNhomGC = T_JOB.IDNhomGC) INNER JOIN T_KyHanGC ON T_JOB.IDjobno = T_KyHanGC.IDJobNo) INNER JOIN T_ThoiLuongGC ON T_KyHanGC.IDKyHanGC = T_ThoiLuongGC.IDKyHanGC
WHERE (((Year([NgayGC]))=Year(Now())) AND ((Month([NgayGC]))=Month(Now())))
GROUP BY T_ThietKe.IDMaKhuon, T_JOB.HanGiaoHang, T_NhomGC.TenNhomGC, T_JOB.IDjobno, T_ThoiLuongGC.NgayGC
ORDER BY T_JOB.HanGiaoHang;

SELECT tblJOB.JobID, tblProcessingDeadline.ProcessingDeadlineID, tblProcessingDeadline.IDCapDC, tblProcessingDeadline.ProcessingDeadline, tblWorkLog.ProcessingCodeID, tblWorkLog.ProcessingDate, tblWorkLog.ProcessingNotes, tblWorkLog.ProcessingTime, tblEmployee.EmployeeID, tblProcessingCode.ProcessingName, tblJOB.DeliveryDeadline, tblEmployee.EmployeeName, tblJOB.jobID AS IDjobno, tblJOB.JobName
FROM tblJOB INNER JOIN (tblProcessingCode INNER JOIN (tblProcessingDeadline INNER JOIN (tblEmployee INNER JOIN tblWorkLog ON tblEmployee.[EmployeeID] = tblWorkLog.[EmployeeID]) ON tblProcessingDeadline.[ProcessingDeadlineID] = tblWorkLog.[ProcessingDeadlineID]) ON tblProcessingCode.[ProcessingCodeID] = tblWorkLog.[ProcessingCodeID]) ON tblJOB.JobID = tblProcessingDeadline.JobID;

SELECT [KhuonGiaCongJOBtbl].IDjobno, [KhuonGiaCongJOBtbl].HanGiaoHang, [NhomGCtbl].TenNhomGC, [KhuonGiaCongJOBtbl].KyThang, [KhuonGiaCongJOBtbl].KyNam, [KhuonDatHangTbl].[IDMaKhuonDH]
FROM ((KhuonDatHangTbl INNER JOIN KhuonThietKeTbl ON [KhuonDatHangTbl].[IDMaKhuonDH]=[KhuonThietKeTbl].[IDMaKhuonDH]) INNER JOIN (NhomGCtbl INNER JOIN KhuonGiaCongJOBtbl ON [NhomGCtbl].IDNhomGC=[KhuonGiaCongJOBtbl].IDNhomGC) ON [KhuonThietKeTbl].[IDMaKhuonThietKe]=[KhuonGiaCongJOBtbl].[IDMaKhuonThietKe]) INNER JOIN KyHanGCTbl ON [KhuonGiaCongJOBtbl].IDjobno=[KyHanGCTbl].IDJobNo
GROUP BY [KhuonGiaCongJOBtbl].IDjobno, [KhuonGiaCongJOBtbl].HanGiaoHang, [NhomGCtbl].TenNhomGC, [KhuonGiaCongJOBtbl].KyThang, [KhuonGiaCongJOBtbl].KyNam, [KhuonDatHangTbl].[IDMaKhuonDH]
HAVING ((([KhuonGiaCongJOBtbl].KyThang)=[Month]))
ORDER BY [KhuonGiaCongJOBtbl].HanGiaoHang;

SELECT tblJOB.JobDeadline, tblJOB.JobQuantity, tblJOB.YearPeriod, tblJOB.MonthPeriod, tblItemType.ItemTypeName
FROM (tblMoldDesign INNER JOIN tblJOB ON tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignID = tblJOB.MoldDesignID) INNER JOIN (tblItemType INNER JOIN tblProcessingDeadline ON tblItemType.ItemTypeID = tblProcessingDeadline.ItemTypeID) ON tblJOB.JobID = tblProcessingDeadline.JobID;

SELECT [tblResponsiblePerson].[ResponsiblePerson], [tblItemType2].[ItemTypeName], tblJOB.*, [tblTray].IDMaKhuonDH, KhuonThietKeTbl.*, [tblJOB].[ToleranceY], [tblMachiningCustomer].[MachiningCustomer], [tblJOB].SeihinNote, [KhuonThietKeTbl].PlugAri, [tblJOB].PlugAri, [tblJOB].IDtana, [tblJOB].IDjobno
FROM tblResponsiblePerson INNER JOIN (tblItemType2 INNER JOIN (tblTray INNER JOIN (tblMachiningCustomer INNER JOIN (KhuonThietKeTbl INNER JOIN tblJOB ON KhuonThietKeTbl.IDMaKhuonThietKe=[tblJOB].IDMaKhuonThietKe) ON [tblMachiningCustomer].[MachiningCustomerID]=[tblJOB].[MachiningCustomerID]) ON [tblTray].IDMaKhuonDH=KhuonThietKeTbl.IDMaKhuonDH) ON [tblItemType2].[ItemTypeID]=[tblTray].[ItemTypeID]) ON [tblResponsiblePerson].[ResponsiblePersonID]=[tblJOB].[ResponsiblePersonID];

SELECT T_JOB.IDjobno, T_JOB.HanGiaoHang, T_KyHanGC.HanGC, T_KyHanGC.IDTinhTrangGC, T_NhanVien.TenDayDu, T_KyHanGC.IDKyHanGC, T_MaGC.NoiDungGC, T_ThoiLuongGC.ThoiLuongGC, T_ThoiLuongGC.GhiChuGC, T_ThoiLuongGC.NgayGC, T_ThietKe.IDThietKe, T_ThietKe.IDMaKhuon, Day([NgayGC]) AS [Date]
FROM T_MaGC INNER JOIN (((T_ThietKe INNER JOIN T_JOB ON T_ThietKe.[IDThietKe] = T_JOB.[IDThietKe]) INNER JOIN T_KyHanGC ON T_JOB.IDjobno = T_KyHanGC.IDJobNo) INNER JOIN (T_NhanVien INNER JOIN T_ThoiLuongGC ON T_NhanVien.IDnhanvien = T_ThoiLuongGC.IDNhanVien) ON T_KyHanGC.IDKyHanGC = T_ThoiLuongGC.IDKyHanGC) ON T_MaGC.IDMaGC = T_ThoiLuongGC.IDMaGC
GROUP BY T_JOB.IDjobno, T_JOB.HanGiaoHang, T_KyHanGC.HanGC, T_KyHanGC.IDTinhTrangGC, T_NhanVien.TenDayDu, T_KyHanGC.IDKyHanGC, T_MaGC.NoiDungGC, T_ThoiLuongGC.ThoiLuongGC, T_ThoiLuongGC.GhiChuGC, T_ThoiLuongGC.NgayGC, T_ThietKe.IDThietKe, T_ThietKe.IDMaKhuon, Day([NgayGC]), T_NhanVien.IDnhanvien
HAVING (((T_NhanVien.IDnhanvien)=1))
ORDER BY T_JOB.IDjobno;

SELECT tblCutter.CutterID, tblCutter.CutterNo, tblCutter.MoldDesignID, tblCutter.CutterName, tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignName, tblRackLayer.RackID, tblRackLayer.RackLayerID
FROM tblMoldDesign INNER JOIN ((tblRack INNER JOIN tblRackLayer ON tblRack.RackID = tblRackLayer.RackID) INNER JOIN tblCutter ON tblRackLayer.RackLayerID = tblCutter.RackLayerID) ON tblMoldDesign.MoldDesignID = tblCutter.MoldDesignID;

INSERT INTO tblProductionPlanStep ( ProductionPlanID, StepNo, StepType, MoldID, CutterID, MachineID, EmployeeID, CompanyID, PlannedQty, PlannedStart, PlannedEnd, StepStatus, Notes )
SELECT pp.ProductionPlanID, 1 AS StepNo, 'FORMING' AS StepType, (
        SELECT TOP 1 m.MoldID
        FROM tblMold AS m
        WHERE m.MoldDesignID = ol.MoldDesignID
        ORDER BY m.MoldID DESC
    ) AS MoldID, (
        SELECT TOP 1 mc.CutterID
        FROM tblMoldCutter AS mc
        WHERE mc.MoldDesignID = ol.MoldDesignID
        ORDER BY mc.CutterID DESC
    ) AS CutterID, Null AS MachineID, Null AS EmployeeID, Null AS CompanyID, ol.Quantity AS PlannedQty, Null AS PlannedStart, Null AS PlannedEnd, 'NEW' AS StepStatus, 'Created from batch append' AS Notes
FROM tblOrderLine AS ol INNER JOIN tblProductionPlan AS pp ON ol.OrderLineID = pp.OrderLineID
WHERE NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM tblProductionPlanStep AS pps
        WHERE
            pps.ProductionPlanID = pp.ProductionPlanID
            AND pps.StepNo = 1
    );

SELECT TOP 1 c.CustomerID, t.TrayID, md.MoldDesignID, m.MoldID, cu.CutterID, cu.CutterNo
FROM (((tblMold AS m INNER JOIN tblMoldDesign AS md ON m.MoldDesignID = md.MoldDesignID) INNER JOIN tblTray AS t ON md.TrayID = t.TrayID) INNER JOIN tblCustomer AS c ON md.CustomerID = c.CustomerID) INNER JOIN tblCutter AS cu ON cu.MoldDesignID = md.MoldDesignID
WHERE m.MoldRevisionID IS NOT NULL
    AND md.DesignMasterID IS NOT NULL
    AND cu.CutterMasterID IS NOT NULL
    AND t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

SELECT to1.TrayOrderID, to1.TrayOrderDate, to1.CustomerID, c.CustomerShortName, to1.TrayID, t.MoldTrayName, to1.TrayOderQuantity, (
        SELECT
            TOP 1 md.MoldDesignID
        FROM
            tblMoldDesign AS md
        WHERE
            md.CustomerID = to1.CustomerID
            AND md.TrayID = to1.TrayID
        ORDER BY
            md.MoldDesignID DESC
    ) AS SuggestedMoldDesignID, (
        SELECT
            TOP 1 m.MoldID
        FROM
            tblMold AS m
        WHERE
            m.MoldDesignID = (
                SELECT
                    TOP 1 md2.MoldDesignID
                FROM
                    tblMoldDesign AS md2
                WHERE
                    md2.CustomerID = to1.CustomerID
                    AND md2.TrayID = to1.TrayID
                ORDER BY
                    md2.MoldDesignID DESC
            )
        ORDER BY
            m.MoldID DESC
    ) AS SuggestedMoldID, (
        SELECT
            TOP 1 mc.CutterID
        FROM
            tblMoldCutter AS mc
        WHERE
            mc.MoldDesignID = (
                SELECT
                    TOP 1 md2.MoldDesignID
                FROM
                    tblMoldDesign AS md2
                WHERE
                    md2.CustomerID = to1.CustomerID
                    AND md2.TrayID = to1.TrayID
                ORDER BY
                    md2.MoldDesignID DESC
            )
        ORDER BY
            mc.CutterID DESC
    ) AS SuggestedCutterID, (
        SELECT
            TOP 1 cu.CutterNo
        FROM
            tblCutter AS cu
        WHERE
            cu.CutterID = (
                SELECT
                    TOP 1 mc.CutterID
                FROM
                    tblMoldCutter AS mc
                WHERE
                    mc.MoldDesignID = (
                        SELECT
                            TOP 1 md2.MoldDesignID
                        FROM
                            tblMoldDesign AS md2
                        WHERE
                            md2.CustomerID = to1.CustomerID
                            AND md2.TrayID = to1.TrayID
                        ORDER BY
                            md2.MoldDesignID DESC
                    )
                ORDER BY
                    mc.CutterID DESC
            )
        ORDER BY
            cu.CutterID DESC
    ) AS SuggestedCutterNo
FROM (tblTrayOrder AS to1 INNER JOIN tblCustomer AS c ON to1.CustomerID = c.CustomerID) INNER JOIN tblTray AS t ON to1.TrayID = t.TrayID
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT
            *
        FROM
            tblOrderLine AS ol
        WHERE
            ol.TrayOrderID = to1.TrayOrderID
    )
ORDER BY to1.TrayOrderDate, to1.TrayOrderID;
